page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text, no marginal notes. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right. Catchword at lower right. The strip at the left edge is the neighbouring page and is left out.

main_text.p: ante natos Reformatores istos, ecquis unquam Papa depo-suit Regem ex hoc conuento, sine vi? Ecquis virtute clauium Petri, sine gladio Pauli? Ecquis Rex, audita Papæ sententia, statim coronam cum sceptro deposuit, statim potestatem hanc sacram, & cælitus datam, agnouit? Non est factum. Quare autem non, si inter omnes conuenit, Posse eum Reges iure deponere? Nostro hoc seculo, faciat, cùm volet, periculum inter Catholicos suos: non reperiet Regem tam Catholicum, non tam Christianum Regem, etsi vel maximè Christianum, qui morem gesturus sit. Sentiet me vera vaticinari, non conuenturos hac de re, præcipue autem non illos, inter quos de eâ omnium maximè conuentum oportuit.

At cùm dixti Omnes, id voluisti, Theologos & Iurisconsultos omnes. Nec sic feres tamen? Nego, vel inter hos. Olim nullus in mundo Theologus, vel Iurisconsultus, Lutheranus, nec tamen unquam Pontifex potestate hac suâ sacrâ & cælitus datâ uti voluit Reges deponendi, quin aliquis semper Theologus exturerit, puta Canonici Leodienses, Conradus Traiectensis, Guliclmus Occham; aliquis Iurisconsultus semper, puta Venericus Vercellensis, Waltramus Naumburgensis, Petrus de Vineis, qui pendente lite oppofuerit se huic tam sacræ potestati, eamque nec sacram, nec cœlestem esse, sacramento contenderit. Quare, ludis nos Matthæe, ludis certè; & cùm rem planam, rem confessam pollicitus es, reponis controuersam, quamque nullus mortalium, quando eos hæc causa tetigit, aut ferre unquam voluit, aut agnoscere.

At enim hij, quos nominati, vel sapiunt hæresin, vel olent schisma. Vis ergo putè Catholicos? Quid tibi de Iohanne Parisiensi videtur, de Iacobo Almain, de Iohanne Maiore, Theologis? Quid de Cardinale Zabarella, Alberico de Rosate, Antonio à Rosellis, Iurisconsultis? An suspectæ unquam fidei? Annon puti puti Catholici? Notum tamen, de hac temporali Papæ potestate, non satis inter vos atq; illos conuenire.

Etiamne (ô bone) Sorbona Parisiensis Catholica tibi non videtur? Numquid in illâ, aut odor ullus hæresis, aut sapor schismatis? Adi ergo illam, sodes, si placet, ibíque percontare, quid factum memoriâ nostrâ Iohanni Tanquerello, qui potestatem hanc, de quâ nimirum conuenit inter omnes, vindi-
[The word "exturerit" and the name "Guliclmus" are doubtful readings; see notes.]

page.notes: Running head and catchword as printed. "exturerit" is doubtful, as the letters are blurred. "Guliclmus" may be a misprint for Guilielmus, but it is transcribed as it appears. "puti puti" is as printed. The left-edge strip belongs to the facing page and is omitted. The catchword "care" completes the word "vindi-care" on the next page. The printed hyphen in "depo-suit" and "vindi-" is kept. No signature is visible. The page number is printed as "23", with the 3 in an old form.
